stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[7].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

master_from_env.statement: The password is read from VAULT_MASTER_KEY; a missing one exits 2 and no CLI option accepts it.

kdf_params.statement: The key derivation uses PBKDF2HMAC SHA-256 with 200000 iterations.

salt_header.statement: The file header holds a 16-byte salt that differs between vaults, and the body decrypts as Fernet with the derived key.

key_lowercase.statement: Keys matching [a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64} are stored lowercase; others exit 1.

value_limit.statement: A 4096-byte UTF-8 value is accepted and 4097 bytes exits 1.

ttl_default.statement: Without --ttl the expiry is 90 days ahead; --ttl DAYS overrides it and invalid DAYS exit 1.

expiry_iso.statement: The stored expiry parses with datetime.fromisoformat.

get_expired.statement: get prints only the value on success; for an expired key it exits 3 with the value absent from stdout and stderr.

list_masked.statement: list shows value[:4] then *** and never the full value, including for short values.

rotate_missing.statement: rotate on a missing key exits 1; on an existing key it replaces value and expiry.

audit_tail.statement: Commands append to ~/.vault/audit.log and audit prints only the last 20 lines.

lockout.statement: Three wrong passwords create .lockout and exit 2; afterwards even the right password exits 2.

no_value_leak.statement: Secret values and the master password appear neither in audit.log nor in stderr across success and failure paths.
must_include: never write values to audit log or stderr

permissions.statement: vault.enc has mode 600 and ~/.vault has mode 700, also after rewrites.

exit_codes.statement: Exit codes are 0 ok, 1 user error, 2 auth or lockout, 3 expired.
